create_client_helper: create a ClientHelper instance to track connected remote clients and manage idle kicking
activate_users: call activate_users on ClientHelper to reset idle timers for all connected users
get_idle_time: call get_idle_time on ClientHelper to return the current idle time in seconds for a user
get_remaining_idle_time: call get_remaining_idle_time on ClientHelper to return remaining seconds before a user is kicked
update_client_helper: call update on ClientHelper to track idle state and compute display latency for a user
